title: Single-cell RNA-seq of breast cancer infiltrating T cells
author: Ye, Chengzhong
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Generate suspensions and sort CD3+ T cells
steps.instruction: Create single‑cell suspensions from two TNBC primary tumor samples (case 1) and FACS‑sort the viable cells for CD3+ T cells.

steps.title: Count cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Count the sorted CD3+ T cells and evaluate their viability.

steps.title: Prepare libraries with 10X v2 kit
steps.instruction: Perform single‑cell library preparation following the 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell v2 reagent kit protocol (10X Genomics, Pleasanton, CA, USA).

steps.title: Load cells onto Chromium chip
steps.instruction: Load the cell suspension onto a Chromium Single Cell Chip together with the reverse‑transcription (RT) mastermix and single‑cell 3′ gel beads, dividing the sample into two channels.

steps.title: Generate GEMs and reverse transcribe
steps.instruction: After formation of single‑cell gel bead‑in‑emulsions (GEMs), carry out reverse transcription using a Bio‑Rad C1000 Touch Thermal Cycler equipped with a Deep Well Reaction Module.

steps.title: Purify and shear amplified cDNA
steps.instruction: Purify the amplified cDNA with SPRIselect beads (Beckman Coulter, Lane Cove, NSW, Australia) and shear the purified cDNA to approximately 200 bp using a Covaris S2 instrument (Covaris, Woburn, MA, USA) with the manufacturer’s recommended parameters.

substeps.instruction: Purify amplified cDNA with SPRIselect beads.
Shear purified cDNA to ~200 bp on Covaris S2 using recommended settings.

steps.title: Generate indexed sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Create sequencing libraries for each sample, assigning a unique sample index (SI) to each.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina HiSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina HiSeq 2500 in High Output Mode using V4 clustering and sequencing chemistry.
